FIELDS.NAME: Beverage Haven Distributors
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Beverage Haven Distributors specializes in the wholesale distribution of a diverse range of alcoholic beverages, including beer, liquor, and wine. Our operations focus on delivering quality products to licensed retailers, bars, restaurants, and other establishments across the region. We prioritize compliance with all federal, state, and local alcohol regulations to ensure legal operation and minimize risks. Our team is trained in responsible beverage service, including age verification procedures to prevent underage sales. With a well-managed supply chain established with licensed manufacturers and importers, we guarantee a reliable inventory that meets the demands of our customers. Our facilities are equipped with measures to protect our valuable stock, ensuring we maintain excellent service delivery and operational integrity.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Beverage Haven Spirits LLC, 456 Spirits Way, Springfield, IL 62701
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss incurred on 06/15/2023 due to damage from a severe storm causing water intrusion in storage area, resulting in a loss of $4,500. Status: Resolved. Loss on 09/10/2023 from theft of merchandise valued at $4,000. Status: In progress with police report filed. Total losses amount to $8,500.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, Grade II, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system with motion detectors and regular monitoring by an external security service.

FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its operations. The focus remains solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our compliance team to ensure all required coverage is in place.

The business maintains a commitment to compliance and ethical operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Beverage Haven Distributors has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance policies have been maintained without interruption.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staffing is managed internally.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Beverage Haven Distributors carries workers' compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect our employees during operational activities.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Beverage Haven Distributors also owns and operates Beverage Haven Spirits LLC, which is located at 456 Spirits Way, Springfield, IL 62701.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Beverage Haven Distributors currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. The only policy listed is the primary coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Beverage Haven Distributors is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages to licensed retailers and establishments.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Beverage Haven Distributors has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The company maintains a stable financial position and complies with all operational requirements.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages without engaging in hazardous material handling.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not have any known catastrophe exposure that would pose a significant risk to operations or assets. The company prioritizes compliance and risk management to mitigate potential threats.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Beverage Haven Distributors has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a commitment to ethical operations and compliance with all applicable regulations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Beverage Haven Distributors has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations to ensure a safe operating environment.
